info.title: ShopperStop core API
info.description: The core service: catalogue, carts, orders and accounts for the ShopperStop storefront and admin panel. Every error is the envelope {"error": {code, message, field?, productIds?}}. Routes that need a signed-in customer take Authorization: Bearer <token>, the token that sign-in or register returned.

tags.name: accounts
tags.description: Customer sign-up, sign-in, sign-out and profile.

tags.name: admin-staff
tags.description: Staff sign-in, sign-out and the signed-in staff user for the admin panel.

tags.name: serviceability
tags.description: Which store delivers to a pincode, and its public details.

tags.name: admin-stores
tags.description: Admin management of stores and the pincodes they serve.

tags.name: admin-catalog
tags.description: Admin catalog: the two-level category tree, then products and images.

tags.name: catalog
tags.description: Public catalog: a store's category tree and products, and the product and category images, served without a token.

tags.name: stock
tags.description: Per-store stock: a store's product quantities for its staff and the admin stock page.

tags.name: cart
tags.description: The signed-in customer's one cart: its lines at one store, live totals, and setting or clearing lines.

tags.name: orders
tags.description: Placing, reading, cancelling and moving orders: the customer's own orders and each store's orders for its staff.

get.description: Answers 200 whenever the process is up. Does not touch the database.
Answers 200 when the database answers a ping within 2 seconds. Answers 503 with code internal otherwise.

503.description: The database did not answer within 2 seconds.

post.description: Creates a customer and a session, and answers with the token and the customer. The email is unique without regard to case; the password is 8 to 72 bytes and is stored as a bcrypt hash of cost 12. Every attempt counts against its email and its client IP: the eleventh attempt for one email within an hour, or the hundred and first from one IP, answers 429.

201.description: The customer is registered and signed in.

400.description: A field is missing or invalid. The field names the JSON member.

409.description: The email is already registered, in any case.

429.description: Too many attempts for this email or from this IP within the hour.

error.message: too many attempts, try again later

post.description: Creates a new session and answers with its token and the customer. Other sessions of the customer stay signed in. A wrong password and an unknown email answer the same 401. Shares the registration rate limit: attempts count per email and per client IP.

400.description: The email is not an email address, or the password is empty.

error.message: must be a valid email address

401.description: The email is unknown or the password is wrong. The two cases look the same.

429.description: Too many attempts for this email or from this IP within the hour.

error.message: too many attempts, try again later

post.description: Ends the session of the bearer token and nothing else: the customer's other sessions stay signed in.

204.description: The session is ended. No body.

401.description: The token is missing, unknown, expired or a staff token.

get.description: Answers the customer the bearer token belongs to. A customer session slides: each use after an hour moves its expiry 30 days on.

200.description: The signed-in customer. phone is omitted when it is empty.

401.description: The token is missing, unknown, expired or a staff token.

patch.summary: Change the signed-in customer's name or phone
patch.description: Changes only the fields present. An empty phone clears it, and a cleared phone is omitted from responses. A null value is refused with 400 naming the field; an empty object changes nothing.

400.description: A field is invalid, or a member is null. The field names the member.

error.message: must be empty or 10 to 15 digits, optionally after +

401.description: The token is missing, unknown, expired or a staff token.

get.description: Answers one page of the signed-in customer's addresses, the default first, then newest first. total counts every address, not just this page. page and pageSize are optional; a value out of range or not a whole number is 400 naming the parameter.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Items per page, from 1 to 100. Default 24.

200.description: One page of addresses. items is [] when the customer has none.

400.description: page or pageSize is out of range or not a whole number. The field names the parameter.

401.description: The token is missing, unknown, expired or a staff token.

post.description: Creates an address for the signed-in customer and answers 201 with it. isDefault true makes it the only default: the previous default is cleared in the same transaction. A new address is never made default by itself. An empty line2 is omitted from responses.

400.description: A field is invalid. The field names it: label, line1, line2 or pincode.

error.message: must be six digits, not starting with 0

401.description: The token is missing, unknown, expired or a staff token.

patch.description: Changes only the fields present. An empty line2 clears it and it is then omitted. isDefault true clears the customer's previous default in the same transaction. A null value is refused with 400 naming the field. Another customer's address, or an id that is not one, answers 404.

400.description: A field is invalid, or a member is null. The field names it.

401.description: The token is missing, unknown, expired or a staff token.

404.description: No address with this id belongs to the customer.

delete.description: Deletes the address. Deleting the default address is allowed; the customer then has no default until one is set. Another customer's address, or an id that is not one, answers 404.

204.description: The address is deleted. No body.

401.description: The token is missing, unknown, expired or a staff token.

404.description: No address with this id belongs to the customer.

get.description: The signed-in customer's cart: its store, its lines and its totals, computed now from the products' current prices. Each line's product carries its stock at the cart's store. A customer with no cart gets the empty cart: no storeId, items [] and every amount 0. The delivery fee is the store's, or 0 when the subtotal is at or above its free-delivery threshold; totalCents is the subtotal plus the fee; shortfallCents is what is missing to free delivery, never below 0. A deactivated product stays in the cart with inStock false and quantity 0. A missing token, an unknown token or a staff token answers 401.

401.description: The token is missing, unknown, expired, deactivated or a staff token.

delete.description: Deletes the signed-in customer's cart and all its lines. Answers 204 also when the customer has no cart. A missing token, an unknown token or a staff token answers 401.

204.description: The cart is cleared. No body.

401.description: The token is missing, unknown, expired, deactivated or a staff token.

put.description: Sets the quantity of one product in the signed-in customer's cart to exactly quantity, creating the cart and the line when absent; it is not added to. A quantity of 0 removes the line, and the cart is deleted when its last line goes. storeId must name an existing store whatever the quantity, and a quantity from 1 to 20 also needs productId to name an active product. Each field is checked in turn, and the first refused field answers 400 naming it, with the cart unchanged. A quantity above 0 for a store other than the cart's empties the cart and moves it to that store, answering replaced true, unless that store holds none of the product: then the cart is left as it is and the answer is clamped true and replaced false; a quantity of 0 for another store changes nothing. A quantity above the stock the store holds is cut to that stock and answers clamped true; with no stock the line is absent. Answers 200 with the cart as GET /me/cart returns it, plus replaced and clamped. A missing token, an unknown token or a staff token answers 401.

200.description: The cart after the change, with replaced and clamped.

400.description: storeId or productId is not a uuid, quantity is missing or outside 0 to 20, the store is unknown, or the product is inactive or unknown. The field names it; the cart is unchanged.

401.description: The token is missing, unknown, expired, deactivated or a staff token.

get.description: The customer's own orders, newest first, one page at a time: page from 1 (default 1), pageSize from 1 to 100 (default 24). Each order carries its items as they were at placement and its status history, oldest event first. Another customer's orders are never listed; a customer with no orders gets an empty items array and total 0. Errors: 400 validation naming pageSize (must be from 1 to 100) or page (must be at least 1, or must be a whole number); 401 with no token, an unknown token or a staff token.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Items per page, from 1 to 100. Default 24.

200.description: One page of the customer's orders, newest first. An empty items array when the customer has none.

400.description: page is not a whole number or below 1 (field page), or pageSize is not a whole number or outside 1 to 100 (field pageSize).

401.description: The token is missing, unknown, expired, deactivated or a staff token.

post.summary: Place an order from the cart
post.description: Turns the signed-in customer's whole cart into one order at the cart's store, in one transaction, and empties the cart. The address must be one of the customer's own, its pincode must be served by the cart's store, the store must be open, and the subtotal must reach the store's minimum order. Every cart line must be in stock: placement takes the stock, and a line whose product is inactive or short of stock refuses the whole order and names every such product. The subtotal is each line's current price times its quantity; the delivery fee is the store's, or 0 at or above its free-delivery amount. The order keeps snapshots of the address, the customer's name and phone, and each item's name, unit label, image, price and MRP. Answers 201 with the order, status placed. A refused placement changes nothing: the cart and the stock stay as they were. Errors: 400 validation with no field when the cart is empty; 400 naming addressId when it is missing (required), not a uuid (must be a uuid) or not the customer's (unknown address); 400 naming subtotal when it is below the store's minimum order; 401 with no token, an unknown token or a staff token; 409 not_serviceable naming addressId when the store does not deliver to the address, and 409 not_serviceable with no field when the store is closed; 409 out_of_stock with productIds; 409 conflict when the order number collides, which is rare, and the client may retry.

201.description: The order, placed. The cart is empty afterwards.

400.description: The cart is empty (no field), or addressId is missing (required), not a uuid (must be a uuid) or not one of the customer's addresses (unknown address), or the subtotal is below the store's minimum order (field subtotal). Nothing changes.

401.description: The token is missing, unknown, expired, deactivated or a staff token.

409.description: The store does not deliver to the address (not_serviceable, field addressId), the store is closed (not_serviceable, no field), some cart products are inactive or short of stock (out_of_stock, with productIds listing each one, ascending), or the order number collided (conflict; retry). Nothing changes.

notServiceable.summary: The store does not deliver to the address

error.message: the store does not deliver to this address

outOfStock.summary: A cart product is short of stock

error.message: some products are out of stock

get.summary: Read one of the signed-in customer's orders
get.description: The customer's own order with this id: its items and snapshots as they were at placement, and its status history, oldest event first. Another customer's order, and an id that names no order or is not a uuid, answer 404 not_found: the same answer, so existence does not leak. 401 with no token, an unknown token or a staff token.

401.description: The token is missing, unknown, expired, deactivated or a staff token.

404.description: No order of the signed-in customer has this id: unknown, another customer's, or not a uuid.

post.summary: Cancel one of the signed-in customer's orders
post.description: Cancels the customer's own order while it is placed or accepted: its status becomes cancelled, the optional reason is recorded as cancelReason and as the event's note, and each line's quantity goes back to the store's stock in the same transaction. Send {} for no reason; a body that is not JSON is refused. Errors: 400 validation naming reason when it is longer than 500 characters, and 400 validation (invalid JSON, no field) when the body is missing or malformed; 401 with no token, an unknown token or a staff token; 404 not_found when the order is another customer's, unknown or not a uuid; 409 conflict when the order is packing, ready, out for delivery, delivered or cancelled, and nothing changes.

200.description: The order, cancelled. Its quantities are back in the store's stock.

400.description: The body is not JSON (invalid JSON, no field), or the reason is longer than 500 characters (field reason). Nothing changes.

401.description: The token is missing, unknown, expired, deactivated or a staff token.

404.description: No order of the signed-in customer has this id: unknown, another customer's, or not a uuid.

409.description: The order is packing, ready, out for delivery, delivered or cancelled: a customer may cancel only while it is placed or accepted. Nothing changes.

error.message: cannot move an order from packing to cancelled

get.summary: Read one order of a store
get.description: Admins for any order; store staff only for orders of their own store. The order with this id as the customer sees it: its items, its status history oldest first, the customer's name and phone and the delivery address. Store staff of another store, an unknown id and an id that is not a uuid answer 404 not_found, the same answer. 401 with no token, an unknown token or a customer token. A service token (SHOPPERSTOP_CORE_SERVICE_TOKENS) is admitted as an unscoped reader, like an admin.

401.description: The token is missing, unknown, expired, deactivated or a customer token.

404.description: No order has this id, the signed-in store staff's store does not own it, or the id is not a uuid. Nothing changes.

post.summary: Move an order to another status
post.description: Admins for any order; store staff only for orders of their own store. Moves the order along the table: placed to accepted or cancelled; accepted to packing or cancelled; packing to ready; ready to out_for_delivery; out_for_delivery to delivered. Every move appends one event with its note. A cancel also returns each line's quantity to the store's stock, and its note becomes the order's cancelReason. A status outside the seven, a body that is not JSON, or a note longer than 500 characters, or an actor the rules refuse, answers 400; a move the table does not allow answers 409 conflict. Both change nothing. Store staff of another store, an unknown order and an id that is not a uuid answer 404 not_found, and nothing changes. 401 with no token, an unknown token or a customer token. A service token is admitted and must name the rider in actor; it may move an order only to out_for_delivery or delivered, and anything else answers 403. Staff name no actor. The rider's name is kept on the order as riderName (set by the move to out_for_delivery) and on the event as actorName.

200.description: The order after the move, with the new event last.

400.description: The status is not one of the seven (field status), the note is longer than 500 characters (field note), an actor is missing from a service, refused from staff, or not a rider, a uuid or a name of 1 to 80 characters (field actor), or the body is not JSON (no field). Nothing changes.

error.message: must be one of placed, accepted, packing, ready, out_for_delivery, delivered, cancelled

401.description: The token is missing, unknown, expired, deactivated or a customer token.

403.description: A service moving the order to any status but out_for_delivery or delivered. Nothing changes.

error.message: a service may only move an order to out_for_delivery or delivered

404.description: No order has this id, the signed-in store staff's store does not own it, or the id is not a uuid. Nothing changes.

409.description: The table does not allow the move, for example placed to packing, or the order is already delivered or cancelled. Nothing changes.

error.message: cannot move an order from placed to packing

get.summary: Today's orders, low stock and revenue for each store
get.description: Admins get every store, by name. Store staff get their own store only. Today starts at midnight Asia/Kolkata: ordersToday counts the orders placed today by their current status, and revenueTodayCents is the total of the orders delivered today. isOpen is the store's open switch. lowStockCount counts the active products below 5 at the store. A missing token, an unknown one or a customer token answers 401.

200.description: One line per store the caller may see.

401.description: The token is missing, unknown, expired, deactivated or a customer token.

403.description: A service token: services reach only the routes marked x-service-token.

post.description: Creates a session for an active staff user and answers its token and the staff user. Staff sessions end 12 hours after sign-in and use does not extend them. A wrong password, an unknown email, a customer's email and an inactive staff user answer the same 401. Shares the sign-in rate limit: attempts count per email and per client IP.

200.description: The staff user is signed in. storeId is present for store staff only.

400.description: The email is not an email address, or the password is empty.

error.message: must be a valid email address

401.description: Any failed sign-in: wrong password, unknown email, customer credentials or inactive staff user. The four cases look the same.

429.description: Too many attempts for this email or from this IP within the hour.

error.message: too many attempts, try again later

post.description: Ends the session of the bearer token and nothing else: the staff user's other sessions stay signed in.

204.description: The session is ended. No body.

401.description: The token is missing, unknown, expired, a customer token, or belongs to a deactivated staff user.

403.description: A service token: services reach only the routes marked x-service-token.

get.description: Answers the staff user the bearer token belongs to. A customer token is refused with 401.

401.description: The token is missing, unknown, expired, a customer token, or belongs to a deactivated staff user.

403.description: A service token: services reach only the routes marked x-service-token.

get.description: Admins only. Answers one page of staff users ordered by email, admins and store staff alike. page and pageSize are optional; a value out of range or not a whole number is 400 naming the parameter. total counts every staff user, not just this page.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Items per page, from 1 to 100. Default 24.

200.description: One page of staff users. items is [] when there are none.

400.description: page or pageSize is out of range or not a whole number. The field names the parameter.

401.description: The token is missing, unknown, expired, deactivated or a customer token.

403.description: The signed-in staff user is store staff. Staff users are admin-only. A service token gets the same 403 with message staff only.

post.description: Admins only. Creates an active staff user from email, password, name, role and storeId. role is admin or store_staff; storeId is required for store_staff and refused for admin. The password is stored at bcrypt cost 12. An email taken in any letter case answers 409 on field email. The new user signs in at /admin/auth/sign-in at once.

201.description: The staff user is created. storeId is present for store staff only.

400.description: A field is invalid. role must be admin or store_staff; storeId is required for store_staff and refused for admin. The field names the problem.

401.description: The token is missing, unknown, expired, deactivated or a customer token.

403.description: The signed-in staff user is store staff. Staff users are admin-only. A service token gets the same 403 with message staff only.

409.description: The email is already registered, in any letter case.

patch.description: Admins only. Changes only the fields present: name; password, which replaces the old one at once (the old one then fails to sign in); isActive, where false ends the user's signed-in sessions at their next request. Role and store cannot change; create a new staff user instead. An admin may deactivate their own account while another admin is active; deactivating the only active admin answers 409 and changes nothing (core-admin create-admin with another email makes a new admin). A null value is refused with 400 naming the field. An id that is not one answers 404.

400.description: A field is invalid, or a member is null. The field names it.

401.description: The token is missing, unknown, expired, deactivated or a customer token.

403.description: The signed-in staff user is store staff. Staff users are admin-only. A service token gets the same 403 with message staff only.

404.description: No staff user has this id.

409.description: The patch sets isActive false on the only active admin. Nothing is changed.

error.message: cannot deactivate the last active admin

get.description: Admins only. Answers one page of stores, admin view (with addressLine and pincode), ordered by name then id. page and pageSize are optional; a value out of range or not a whole number is 400 naming the parameter. total counts every store, not just this page. A service token (SHOPPERSTOP_CORE_SERVICE_TOKENS) is admitted as an unscoped reader, like an admin.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Items per page, from 1 to 100. Default 24.

401.description: The token is missing, unknown, expired, deactivated or a customer token.

403.description: The signed-in staff user is store staff. Store administration is admin-only, whichever store it names.

200.description: One page of stores. items is [] when there are none.

400.description: page or pageSize is out of range or not a whole number. The field names the parameter.

post.description: Admins only. Creates a store from name, addressLine, pincode and promisedMinutes, plus any of isOpen, deliveryFeeCents, freeDeliveryAboveCents and minOrderCents. A new store is closed unless isOpen is true, and an absent money field is 0. The store serves no pincode until its service areas are set. Name and addressLine are trimmed; an explicit null is refused, and every bad field answers 400 validation naming it, and nothing is written.

401.description: The token is missing, unknown, expired, deactivated or a customer token.

403.description: The signed-in staff user is store staff. Store administration is admin-only, whichever store it names. A service token gets the same 403 with message staff only.

201.description: The new store, admin view. Closed, with no pincode served yet.

400.description: A field is missing or out of range. The field names it; nothing is written.

get.description: Admins only. The store with the path id with its address and pincode. An id that is not a store, or not a uuid, answers 404 not_found. A service token (SHOPPERSTOP_CORE_SERVICE_TOKENS) is admitted as an unscoped reader, like an admin.

401.description: The token is missing, unknown, expired, deactivated or a customer token.

403.description: The signed-in staff user is store staff. Store administration is admin-only, whichever store it names.

404.description: No store has this id, or the id is not a uuid.

patch.description: Admins only. Changes only the fields present: name, addressLine, pincode, isOpen (false closes the store at once), and the money and minutes fields. Each present value is checked as on create; a bad one answers 400 naming it and changes nothing. A null value is refused with 400 naming the field. {} answers the store unchanged. An unknown id answers 404.

401.description: The token is missing, unknown, expired, deactivated or a customer token.

403.description: The signed-in staff user is store staff. Store administration is admin-only, whichever store it names. A service token gets the same 403 with message staff only.

400.description: A present field is null or out of range. The field names it; nothing is changed.

404.description: No store has this id, or the id is not a uuid.

delete.description: Admins only. Deletes the store and its service areas. A store that staff users still refer to cannot be deleted: the answer is 409 conflict, and the store is kept. Remove its staff users first; a store with orders cannot be deleted either. An unknown id answers 404.

401.description: The token is missing, unknown, expired, deactivated or a customer token.

403.description: The signed-in staff user is store staff. Store administration is admin-only, whichever store it names. A service token gets the same 403 with message staff only.

204.description: The store is deleted. No body.

404.description: No store has this id, or the id is not a uuid.

409.description: The store still has staff users (or orders). Nothing is deleted.

get.summary: List the pincodes a store serves
get.description: Admins only. The store's pincodes in ascending order, as one list (not paged; at most 100). A store with none answers an empty list, never null. An unknown id answers 404 not_found.

401.description: The token is missing, unknown, expired, deactivated or a customer token.

403.description: The signed-in staff user is store staff. Store administration is admin-only, whichever store it names. A service token gets the same 403 with message staff only.

404.description: No store has this id, or the id is not a uuid.

put.summary: Replace the pincodes a store serves
put.description: Admins only. Replaces the store's whole list with the pincodes in the body: repeats are ignored and an empty list is allowed. A pincode that another store already serves answers 409 conflict, naming the pincode and that store's id, and nothing changes. A missing or null pincodes, more than 100 entries or a bad pincode answers 400 naming pincodes, and nothing changes. An unknown id answers 404. Two admins claiming the same new pincode at once: the later one answers 409 conflict with the code and message only.

400.description: A missing or null pincodes, more than 100 entries, or a pincode that is not six digits. Names pincodes.

401.description: The token is missing, unknown, expired, deactivated or a customer token.

403.description: The signed-in staff user is store staff. Store administration is admin-only, whichever store it names. A service token gets the same 403 with message staff only.

404.description: No store has this id, or the id is not a uuid.

409.description: A pincode in the list is served by another store. The error names the pincode and that store's id; the store's list is unchanged.

error.message: pincode 560038 is served by another store

get.description: Admins for any store; store staff only for their own store. The store's active products with their quantity there, sorted by name, one page at a time. q (at most 100 characters) keeps products whose name or brand contains it, case-insensitively, with % and _ matched literally. lowStock=true keeps quantities below 5, zero included; any other lowStock value answers 400 naming lowStock. A product with no stock row at the store is listed with quantity 0. A row carries imageUrl when the product has an image. Inactive products are never listed. Another store's staff and an unknown store answer 404 not_found; a missing token or a customer token answers 401.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Case-insensitive part of the name or brand; % and _ match literally. Empty or absent means no filter.

parameters.name: lowStock
parameters.description: true keeps the products whose quantity is below 5, zero included. Absent or false keeps all.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Items per page, from 1 to 100. Default 24.

200.description: One page of the store's stock.

400.description: A q, lowStock, page or pageSize is invalid. The field names it.

401.description: The token is missing, unknown, expired, deactivated or a customer token.

403.description: A service token: services reach only the routes marked x-service-token.

404.description: The signed-in staff user is store staff of another store, or no store has this id, or the id is not a uuid.

put.description: Admins for any store; store staff only for their own store. Sets the quantity of each listed product at the store in one transaction, creating the row where the store has none. Takes 1 to 500 rows; each product id is a uuid, names a product that exists and appears once; each quantity is from 0 to 100000. Any invalid row refuses the whole request with 400 naming the field, and nothing changes. Answers 204 with no body; the admin page reads the list again. Another store's staff and an unknown store answer 404 not_found.

400.description: A row is invalid, or the rows are not 1 to 500, or a product is listed twice or does not exist. The field names it; nothing changed.

401.description: The token is missing, unknown, expired, deactivated or a customer token.

403.description: A service token: services reach only the routes marked x-service-token.

404.description: The signed-in staff user is store staff of another store, or no store has this id, or the id is not a uuid.

get.description: Admins for any store; store staff only for their own store. The store's orders, newest first, one page at a time, each with its items, its status history and the customer's name, phone and delivery address. status keeps one status (placed, accepted, packing, ready, out_for_delivery, delivered or cancelled); empty or absent keeps every status, and any other value answers 400 naming status. active=true keeps every order that is neither delivered nor cancelled, in one list with its total; any other active value, or active=true with a status, answers 400 naming active. Another store's staff and an unknown store answer 404 not_found; a missing token or a customer token answers 401. A service token (SHOPPERSTOP_CORE_SERVICE_TOKENS) is admitted as an unscoped reader, like an admin.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: One status to keep. Empty or absent keeps every status.

parameters.name: active
parameters.description: true keeps every order that is not delivered or cancelled. Only true is accepted; absent or empty keeps every status. Not with status.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Items per page, from 1 to 100. Default 24.

200.description: One page of the store's orders.

400.description: The 400 is for an unknown status value, an active value other than true, active=true with a status, or a page below 1 or a pageSize outside 1 to 100. The field names it.

error.message: must be one of placed, accepted, packing, ready, out_for_delivery, delivered, cancelled

401.description: The token is missing, unknown, expired, deactivated or a customer token.

404.description: The signed-in staff user is store staff of another store, no store has this id, or the id is not a uuid.

get.summary: Find the store that delivers to a pincode
get.description: Public, no session. Answers the one store whose service areas hold the pincode, whether the store is open or closed; check isOpen. A pincode no store serves answers 404 not_serviceable. A missing pincode, or one that is not six digits with a first digit from 1 to 9, answers 400 naming pincode.

200.description: The store that delivers to the pincode, open or closed.

400.description: The pincode is missing or is not six digits starting from 1 to 9.

404.description: No store serves the pincode.

error.message: we do not deliver to this pincode yet

get.description: Public, no session. The fields checkout shows, open or closed; the address and pincode stay admin-only. An id that is not a store, or not a uuid, answers 404 not_found.

get.description: Public, no session. The category tree a store sells from: each parent with its children array, parents and children ordered by sortOrder then name. A category is listed only when it, or one of its children, has an active product with a quantity above 0 at this store. A parent is listed through a stocked child; a child is listed only when it qualifies itself, so out-of-stock children are hidden. The tree is not paged. An unknown store answers 404 not_found.

200.description: The store's category tree, holding only categories in stock there.

get.description: Public, no session. The paged active products a store sells, filtered by q (name or brand) and categoryId (with its children) exactly as the admin list filters them, and by inStock. Ordered by name, or by price with sort (equal prices by name, then id). Inactive products are never listed. Each product carries inStock and quantity at this store; quantity is capped at 10 for display. total counts every match after every filter, not just this page. An unknown store answers 404 not_found; a bad q, categoryId, inStock or sort answers 400 naming the parameter.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Case-insensitive part of the name or brand; % and _ match literally. Empty or absent means no filter.

parameters.name: inStock
parameters.description: true lists only products whose quantity at this store is above 0. false, empty or absent means no filter. Any other value answers 400 naming inStock.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: price_asc: cheapest first; price_desc: dearest first; equal prices by name, then id. Empty or absent: by name, then id. Any other value answers 400 naming sort.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Items per page, from 1 to 100. Default 24.

get.description: Public, no token. Serves a stored product or category image. kind is products or categories and name is a lowercase file name ending in png, jpg or webp; any other shape, and a file that is not stored, answers 404. The Content-Type comes from the extension. Cache-Control is no-cache, so a re-upload that keeps the URL is seen at once. If-Modified-Since answers 304 without a body when the file has not changed.
